name: principles
description: Shared devflow policy and state-free entry routing. Use when the user intends to operate, resume, recover, or inspect the current project through devflow without naming a stage, or asks how devflow's shared workflow rules apply. A named stage enters directly and reads the shared policy index without a Principles preflight.
problem: Keep devflow flexible for people while making mechanical state, recovery, evidence, ownership, and completion decisions deterministic for AI. Prevent prose drift, silent loss, duplicate authority, unbounded reading, and a check-passing workflow that no longer serves the user's development outcome.
use_cases: Route a new or resumed devflow session from current Git and project state.
Preserve and resume research, planning, implementation, verification, and multi-owner landing across sessions.
Choose bounded knowledge and work paths for a small change, one domain, a deep subtopic, or a project-wide change.
Validate exact journal, progress, canonical knowledge-capsule, commit, claim, and verification evidence boundaries.
near_misses: A request that does not use devflow and does not touch a devflow project.
A request to manage Git worktrees; devflow observes worktrees but does not create or manage them.
A request to turn every judgment into a parser rule or to create a second knowledge canon.
inputs: Raw project and Git observations collected from the current project without mutation.
The invoked devflow stage, explicit user choices, and named role results.
Canonical Layer 0 documents, capability owners, recursive K headers, active work cards, journal markers, and exact source locators.
outputs: One fail-closed current Decision: route, ask, wait, block, or ordered effects.
A bounded consumption set that opens only the active work and the nearest current-knowledge owner path needed now.
Evidence requirements for durable landing, reentry, commits, verification, and knowledge closure.
irreversible_boundaries: User confirmation of product, architecture, design, capability, or other binding decisions.
A commit that publishes a task, Layer 0, knowledge refresh, verification, or closure boundary.
Deleting, retiring, renaming, moving, or replacing a canonical owner, work card, knowledge capsule, marker, or source locator.
Claiming pass, completion, migration parity, or knowledge closure without the declared durable evidence.
state_dependent_behaviors: The first non-empty route in the canonical state priority wins; UNKNOWN never becomes absence or success.
Active-work resume and new-work orientation are distinct views over the same disk state.
A passing tweak adds no devflow artifact; uncertainty or durable knowledge exits the tweak lane.
Pre-product multi-session research uses the reserved 00-project work scope but cannot own implementation or masquerade as a capability.
Current knowledge uses only the canonical capability-capsule artifacts projected by project-knowledge; the package introduces no second node schema.

Knowledge landing uses the externally state-owned knowledgeLandingPending family; Arch is the canonical managed writer, while Adopt appears only in the initial unmanaged projection and retained legacy provenance.
Multi-owner closure follows the canonical state and knowledge owners without a parallel landing family.
Closed history is opened only by an exact named card, repair lineage, or a current capsule or Trap source basis.
exact_formats: Canonical journal and Progress machine lines, commit subjects, claim and readiness lines, and status suffixes.
Capability design and verified-zone boundaries and their metadata.
Recursive K header, stable K identity, same-stem parent-child address, source basis, direct consumer, and use-when fields.
The project-state zone and route result schema and the project-knowledge projection, validation, and selection schema.
external_dependencies: Git for shared truth, immutable history, containing revisions, and exact path identity.
Node.js for read-only project-state, project-knowledge, and Skill Rails runtimes.
The user for semantic ownership, ambiguous nearest-owner choices, binding confirmation, and genuine value judgments.
Stage-local devflow packages for product, adopt, arch, design, resume, direct, work, and verify judgment and effects.
completion_evidence: Every old source atom has forward and reverse provenance to a current spec, judgment body, template, collector, fixture, or preserved compatibility source.
Old behavior parity and the C1-C6 redesign scenarios pass with critical omissions and false confirmations equal to zero.
State and knowledge collectors remain read-only; policy, order, formats, ownership, and completion live in the P2 spec.
A fresh AI can resume active work or orient to new work without broad search and can place new knowledge at the correct owner.
Tiny, deep-domain, crosscut, interrupted, multi-owner, and large-corpus scenarios preserve human usability and bounded AI reading.
judgment_points: Choose semantic owner and whether a fact is current knowledge, active work, closed history, or external source.
Decide whether complexity has produced an independent frontier or consumer that warrants a child card or canonical capsule.
Judge research sufficiency, synthesis quality, rejected alternatives, and whether a result actually advances the user's intended outcome.
When repeated fixes stop converging, reconsider the owning structure or ask the user instead of adding exceptions.
deterministic_helpers: project-state observes disk and Git, validates exact shapes, and projects complete route candidates without mutating the project.
project-knowledge projects canonical capsule headers, validates address integrity and source coordinates, and enforces opening budgets.
Skill Rails evaluates guards, route priority, stage and effect order, evidence alignment, and deterministic generated artifacts.
Repository tests compare legacy and migrated behavior, source provenance, platform delivery, and real-use fixtures.
